Class RMIServerConnection

java.lang.Object
java.rmi.server.RemoteObject
java.rmi.server.RemoteServer
java.rmi.server.UnicastRemoteObject
it.polimi.ingsw.am54.network.client.RMIServerConnection
All Implemented Interfaces:
ServerConnection, RMIClientInterface, Serializable, Remote
public class RMIServerConnection extends UnicastRemoteObject implements ServerConnection, RMIClientInterface
Implementazione della connessione client tramite RMI. Si connette al server RMIGameServer, ottiene un handler personale, e implementa RMIClientInterface per ricevere le callback dal server. Gestisce heartbeat (ping/pong) e riconnessione automatica.
